title: Vision transformer on CT predicts grade of laryngeal and hypopharyngeal cancer
summary: In 1648 patients from three hospitals, a pretrained vision transformer extracted CT features for an XGBoost classifier. AUC was 0.887 in internal validation (n = 310) and 0.796 in external validation (n = 99), above a conventional radiomics model (0.775 and 0.544).
ai_technology: Pretrained vision transformer feature extraction with XGBoost classification on contrast-enhanced CT
organization: Beijing Tongren Hospital; Capital Medical University; Beijing Luhe Hospital Affiliated to Capital Medical University

evidence.tested: Internal validation and an external cohort from two other hospitals.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; moderate external AUC; full text not reviewed.
